title: Error re-render doesn't trim `selected`, so a whitespace-padded crafted choice the validator accepted renders with neither radio checked
detail: A posted `" attested "` passes validate_choice (trims) and persists as attested (get_form_value trims), but on an error re-render triggered by another field, `selected` is untrimmed, so `value == selected` is False and neither radio re-checks; resubmit then errors as unanswered. Crafted-POST only; self-correcting.
recommended_fix: Pass `selected: common.get_val(values, reference_attestation.field_name) |> string.trim` in references.gleam so the renderer agrees with the validator and writer.
